page.overview:
What is Keeper?

The Keeper narrates Call of Cthulhu, hiding Mythos truths, adjudicating Sanity loss, and orchestrating the slow revelation of cosmic horror.

Also known as: Keeper of Arcane Lore, CoC Keeper, Game Master.
